name: Menoful: Forbidden Juice
source:
Dolores has only had her period for one year and she already wants to rip her uterus out. Terrible pain and all it's wonderful companions visit her month after month and she is tired of it. At her breaking point she visits a mysterious specialist who supposedly can "change her life", no matter the costs.

[From [url=https://lemonademochi.itch.io/forbiddenjuice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
多洛雷斯的月经才来一年，她就想把自己的子宫切掉。可怕的疼痛和所有美妙的同伴一月复一月地拜访她，她已经厌倦了。在她崩溃的边缘，她拜访了一位神秘的专家，据说他可以不惜一切代价“改变她的生活”。

[来自[url=https://lemonademochi.itch.io/forbiddenjuice]Itch.io[/url]]
